title: Actual strength of Jail Officials during 1995
pdf_title: Actual strength of Jail Officials during 1995
notes: An analysis of the actual staff strength in the jails shows that almost in all the States/UTs from
where information had been supplied, the actual strength of the Jail Staff posted against the sanctioned
strength is very much satisfactory and they are very nearly equal to the sanctioned strength except in
Jammu & Kashmir and Andaman & Nicobar Islands where the posted strength was only 52.91% and
68.51% of the total sanctioned strength. Bihar, Meghalaya and Sikkim could not make available the
actual staff strength in respect of their prisons. Kerala is the only State who has reported full posted
Training of Jail personnel in various aspects of correctional administration is of vital importance
and States/UTs have made use of such facilities available from various National, State level institutions.
Criminology, Management of anti-social and Criminal behaviour, Correctional Administration,
Victimology, Induction Training, Refresher Courses, Prison Management and Drill and Academic were
the few areas in which various categories of jail personnel in States & UTs were trained during the year
